data.change_summary: Fixed CRITICAL pKa1 temperature coefficient error in the carbonate state contract design note and two supporting files. Replaced the erroneous linear approximation pKa1(T) = 6.352 - 0.0238*(T-25) (wrong by ~4.3x) with the full Harned & Davis (1943) formula: pK1 = 3404.71/(T+273.15) + 0.032786*(T+273.15) - 14.8435. Also documented the correct linear approximation (-0.0055/°C) as a fallback with its accuracy bounds (~±0.03 pK units across 15-35°C).
outstanding_risks: The 6 frozen history artifacts in .ralph-burning still contain the old -0.0238 value. These are immutable review records and not referenced by implementation, but could cause confusion if someone reads them without context.

The pH 7.0 fallback for near-zero alkalinity (line 110) remains physically incorrect for CO2-containing water (~pH 5.6 in atmospheric equilibrium). Accepted as a stability guard for the first pass, documented transparently in the design note.

steps.description: Updated docs/carbonate_state_contract.md line 79: replaced wrong -0.0238 linear pKa1 formula with full Harned & Davis (1943) formula, added correct linear approximation as documented alternative with accuracy bounds, and cited the source.

Updated .ralph-burning/projects/tanksim-6e5.4.1/prompt.md line 64: replaced the erroneous -0.0238 coefficient in the bead scientific-reference comment with the Harned & Davis formula and correct linear fallback.
Updated .beads/issues.jsonl tanksim-6e5.4.1 comment: replaced the same erroneous coefficient in the backlog-planner comment to prevent future confusion if the bead is referenced.

Verified remaining 6 occurrences of 0.0238 are in ralph-burning history/runtime artifacts (frozen review records). These are historical logs of the review that found the error and should not be modified.

Numerically validated the Harned & Davis formula: pKa1(25°C) = 6.351 (correct), and confirmed the old coefficient produced errors of 0.17-0.19 pK units at temperature extremes, exceeding the ±0.05 pH accuracy target.

validation_evidence: Harned & Davis formula yields pKa1 = 6.3511 at 25°C, matching the expected reference value of ~6.35.
At 15°C: Harned-Davis gives 6.4195, correct linear gives 6.407, old wrong formula gave 6.590 (error = 0.24 from H-D).
At 35°C: Harned-Davis gives 6.3084, correct linear gives 6.297, old wrong formula gave 6.114 (error = 0.19 from H-D).
Correct linear approximation tracks Harned-Davis to within ±0.013 pK units across 15-35°C, well within the ~±0.03 bound documented.
grep for '0.0238' confirms zero matches in the three updated files; remaining matches are only in frozen history artifacts.
MINOR findings (pH 7.0 fallback, fixed pKa2) were reviewed and left as-is per remediation guidance — both are acceptable for first pass and already transparently documented.
